# 5toolbox

100% Free online file tools for PDF merging, splitting, compressing, protecting, image format conversions, and text utilities.

## Core Features and Tools

* [Merge PDF](https://tools.itsyasin.me/tools/merge-pdf): Combine multiple PDF documents into a single file.
* [Split PDF](https://tools.itsyasin.me/tools/split-pdf): Separate pages or extract specific page ranges from a PDF.
* [Compress PDF](https://tools.itsyasin.me/tools/compress-pdf): Reduce PDF file size using intelligent canvas-based rasterization.
* [Protect PDF](https://tools.itsyasin.me/tools/protect-pdf): Secure PDF files with user/owner passwords.
* [Convert Image](https://tools.itsyasin.me/tools/convert-image): Convert images dynamically between PNG, JPG, WEBP, BMP, and ICO.
* [Resize Image](https://tools.itsyasin.me/tools/resize-image): Change width and height dimensions of an image.
* [Compress Image](https://tools.itsyasin.me/tools/compress-image): Optimize and reduce image file sizes.
* [Word Counter](https://tools.itsyasin.me/tools/word-counter): Count words, characters, sentences, and paragraphs in real-time.
* [Online Clipboard](https://tools.itsyasin.me/tools/online-clipboard): Securely share text snippets across devices with configurable expiration times.
